title.value: MII VS Microbiology LOINC Ontology Colony Count By Culture

description.value: Proposal: LOINC codes of the microbiology request 'Colony count: Colony count — with culture technique asserted', computed by ECL over the LOINC Ontology 2026-10-21. Same, restricted to observables that assert a culture technique (viable counts). Zero on 2026-10-21: counts are modelled without technique. Parts: LOINC enumeration (4, LOINC 2.83), LOINC Ontology observables without LOINC code (0), and the ECL as an intensional include.
